Um distrito aparece quando os empregos f: A district appears when its formal jobs in its activities have a location quotient (the share of those jobs in the city divided by the share in the country) of at least 1.25 and total at least 1,000 or 1% of the city's jobs, or when one of its specialties has a quotient of at least 3 with at least 5,000 jobs or 0.5% of the city's jobs (and never fewer than 1,000). Districts are ranked by how many jobs they have above the national norm; up to 5 per city. Porto also needs a city hex in the water, next to it, or over a river on the map. The city's jobs add up its municipalities; cells that IBGE suppresses are left out, and these values are floors. The city type takes the name of the strongest district, or of a district with a quotient of at least 6 and at least 3% of jobs (in the district or in one of its specialties) when there is one, and the nickname of the specialty when it takes over; 'Federal capital' and 'State capital' only go to cities with the capital.
